summary: Visual-enhancement regression for all 8 public routes (/, /invest, /support, /framework, /ecosystem, /platform, /resources, /store) at 1440px and 390px. All pages load fully with zero console errors and zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth - clientWidth = 0 on every route/viewport). Home cream sections retained: partnerships-section (retain-*: 5, provide-*: 11, partnership-model-*: 4) and research-section (research-area-*: 4) render with full text content (partnerships innerText 1195 chars, research 588 chars) visible above LightSeam gradient overlays. Invest, SupportUs, Framework, Ecosystem, Platform, Resources sections all render intact. Platform per-branch cream sections show 18 branch-platform-* items with no broken images. Framework logos (school-ancra/cynaiah/viearta + framework-statement) all present, zero broken images. Inquiry dialog opens successfully from invest-contact-btn and from resource-btn-res_deck on /resources. resources-faq renders. section-rich/section-rich-alt gradient backgrounds and LightSeam edges sit behind content (z-0, pointer-events-none) without covering text or breaking layout.
seed_data_creation: None - dialogs opened but not submitted.
